text: Congressional studies do not remedy regulators' informational disadvantage because they mostly follow after Congress has already identified concerns and may not provide real-time relevant information before regulatory action is necessary.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Law Dynamic Regulation in a New Institutional Economics Framework (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2267560

isBasedOn.name: Evolution of Law Dynamic Regulation in a New Institutional Economics Framework

abstract: However, these studies mostly follow after Congress identified particular concerns in the regulatory structure or in financial markets. These studies may not provide real-time and relevant information before regulatory action by public rule-makers is necessary.
